we pray for all who have died. we also remember those whose anniversaries occur at this time. may their gentle souls rest in eternal peace. we offer our sympathy to all who are bereaved. november masses for the holy souls : you will find a purple offering envelope in your box of parish envelopes together with a sheet to list the names of your deceased relatives & friends. for those of you who do not use the boxes, there are offering envelopes and sheets available in holy cross. please place the envelopes, with your offering, in the secure safe at the front or back of the church or in the collection basket at the weekend masses. your loved ones will be especially remembered on the feast of all saints, sunday 1st november at 12 noon, feast of all souls , monday 2nd november and at all november masses , including a novena of masses from monday 9th to tuesday 17th, celebrated in the parish. november mass, in memory of all those whose funerals took place in kenmare parish since last year’s remembrance mass in november, will take place on friday 20th november at 7.30pm . everyone is invited to attend especially if you wish to remember a loved one, neighbour or friend. we will be in contact with the families of the deceased regarding the november 20th mass. mission sunday will be held on october 18th when a special second collection will be taken up. the mission sunday collection is vital to financing missionary work worldwide. the mission projects worldwide ar coordinated by missio head office in rome and the money goes di rect from ireland to specific projects worldwide. your generous support of mission sunday is much appreciated. the autumn springs of hope (youth ministry) newsletter is available on the diocesan website.
